summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Guaranteed Flips feature for Payload members-only business club app. Backend APIs working perfectly with 100% success rate. Frontend UI and integration testing successful with all core functionality verified including tier-based access control, opportunity submissions, and admin management.

Dashboard Guaranteed Flips card visible with neon green border
Card navigation to /guaranteed-flips page working
Member tier badge display (Front Line tier shown correctly)
Tier-based section access control (Property and Business unlocked for Front Line)
Locked sections display with required tier information
Member opportunity submission form with textarea
File attachment functionality (PDF, DOC, images validation)
Opportunity submission via POST /api/flips/submit-opportunity
Success message display after submission
Admin view shows all 5 sections unlocked
Admin Member Opportunity Submissions section
Admin can expand submissions to see full details
Admin can mark submissions as reviewed/archived
Admin Tier Access Settings collapsible section
Admin can modify tier requirements via dropdowns
Admin can save tier settings via POST /api/flips/tier-access
GET /api/flips/my-access returns correct member access
GET /api/flips/tier-access returns all section settings
GET /api/flips/admin/submissions returns member submissions
File upload validation (rejects invalid file types)
Empty content validation (returns appropriate error)

Error handling for invalid submission status updates
